meta.about: Post-publication updates for the model answers in data/mains-questions.json. Each entry is a dated, source-linked development, produced by the site's own model (scripts/site-agent.js, agent MainsUpdates) in its own words: a news feed only signals that a real dated event exists, the model writes the sentence, and a word-overlap gate rejects anything that parrots a headline — nothing is copied from any source. The core answers stay hand-authored; this rail only records what changed after they were written. No entry renders until a real update exists.
